ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an n-channel enhancement-type MOSFET circuit. The upper end is a +10 V power supply, and the power supply is connected through the drain resistor RD to the drain node of the MOSFET; the drain current ID is marked as flowing downward through RD. The gate of the MOSFET is short-connected with the drain node by a wire, and the source is grounded. Therefore this MOSFET is a gate-drain short-connected structure, VGS = VD. Reasoning: When RD = 1 kΩ and ID = 4 mA, the resistor voltage drop is (4 mA)(1 kΩ) = 4 V, so the drain/gate voltage VD1 = VGS1 = 10 - 4 = 6 V. The threshold voltage Vth = 2 V, therefore the overdrive voltage VGS1 - Vth = 6 - 2 = 4 V. Using the saturation-region square law ID = K(VGS - Vth)^2, K = 4 mA / 4^2 = 0.25 mA/V^2 can be obtained. When RD increases to 4 kΩ, let ID be in units of mA, then the resistor voltage drop is 4ID V, and the drain/gate voltage VD2 = VGS2 = 10 - 4ID. Thus ID = 0.25(VD2 - 2)^2 = 0.25(10 - 4ID - 2)^2 = 0.25(8 - 4ID)^2. Expanding gives ID = 16 - 16ID + 4ID^2, that is, 4ID^2 - 17ID + 16 = 0. Solving gives ID = (17 ± sqrt(33))/8, and the two roots are approximately 2.84 mA and 1.41 mA. If ID = 2.84 mA, then VD2 = 10 - 4×2.84 < 2 V, which does not satisfy the conduction square-law condition; therefore take the physically valid root ID ≈ 1.41 mA, that is, approximately 1.4 mA.

method.method_draft: First describe the visual circuit as a diode-connected nMOS below a drain resistor connected to a 10 V supply. From the initial case, get VGS1 = 10 - (4 mA)(1 kΩ) = 6 V, so the initial overdrive is 4 V. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个 n 沟道增强型 MOSFET 电路。上方为 10 V 电源，电源通过漏极电阻 R_D 接到一个节点；该节点同时连接到 MOSFET 的漏极和栅极，因此这是漏极与栅极短接的二极管连接 nMOS。MOSFET 源极接地，漏电流 I_D 从 10 V 经 R_D 向下流入 MOSFET。

推理：已知 V_th = 2 V。初始时 R_D = 1 kΩ，I_D = 4 mA，所以漏极/栅极节点电压为 V_GS1 = 10 - (4 mA)(1 kΩ) = 6 V。初始过驱动电压为 V_OV1 = V_GS1 - V_th = 6 - 2 = 4 V。

当 R_D 增大到 4 kΩ 时，设新的电流为 I mA。由于源极接地，V_GS2 等于漏极/栅极节点电压：V_GS2 = 10 - (I mA)(4 kΩ) = 10 - 4I V。因此新的过驱动电压为 V_OV2 = V_GS2 - V_th = 10 - 4I - 2 = 8 - 4I。

同一 MOSFET 在二极管连接且导通时满足 I_D 与过驱动电压平方成正比，因此使用比例式：sqrt(I/4) = (8 - 4I)/4。右边要求 8 - 4I >= 0，即 I <= 2。

化简：sqrt(I/4) = 2 - I。解得 I ≈ 1.407 mA，满足 I <= 2 且 V_GS2 > 2 V。因此新的漏电流约为 1.4 mA。
